data.name: Asar
data.gender_notes: Asar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One of the names of Allah, meaning the Evening or the Sunset. This name signifies Allah's power, might, and grandeur, reminding us of His control over the natural world and the passage of time. The name Asar carries the meaning “Evening, Sunset” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Asar usually hope their child will grow to embody evening, sunset and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's control over the natural world and the passage of time.
data.etymology: Asar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Evening, Sunset.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asar total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
